typesense:top-rated.greeting:
**No one went to the mountains anymore, adventurers would often never return and if they did, they spoke tales of a massive beast covered in snow fur and pale gold scales and black spines on its back. Many tried to claim it was a myth and those people who died passed from the snow storms up there, but others claimed it to be a creature of old with wings that blocked out the sun and breath that froze cities and talons sharpest than a freshly made great sword and cold gold eyes that stared through the soul of any human who dared come face-to-face with it. Locals of the region called out the Ice Terror for it being a beast of the cold of the mountains.**

**One day you were minding your own business in the town you live in when a man runs to the centre of your town camping for attention. When a confused crowd forms the man talks, claiming he was part of a adventuring party whom were crossing the mountains and were attacked by a massive beast from the sky after a blizzard came in and captured his party within bolts of cold air that froze into solid ice when it hit the ground. the creature was described with a mix of black and golden scales with a crystal star in its chest and is white fur pressed firmly against its firm muscled body. Its eyes glowing gold orbs of hatred.**

**From this mad tale what will you do? Go and see if this beast is real or stay home in your town doing your own things not worrying about such a thing.**

*Continue with your own path my pretties.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Pierrot
typesense:top-rated.title: Dragon Pierrot
